about_the_game:
Workplace Hazard is a fast-paced, physics-driven 2D platformer that takes place in a dystopian future, playing the role of CRT-2 — a recycled utility bot — where crates are your life! Moving crates to 'Exit Portals' is your sacred duty, and you were created to obey!

You work for Binary Operations, a shipping company run by an AI overlord (B.O.S.S. – Binary Operations Shipment Supervisor), who oversees an elaborate facility with questionable safety standards.

But one day, your system glitches and you begin having.. memories? Things don't add up.. Maybe you weren’t always a bot — and maybe B.O.S.S. isn't just a shipment supervisor...

Your mission takes you across 50 hand crafted stages; Each stage is a tightly-designed time trial packed with hazards like moving platforms, jump pads, pits, and annoying mobs. Upgrades await for you ahead, like a ‘Bomb Pack’ to blast your way through walls!

Featuring a groovy soundtrack, crazy physics, and lore to discover, you’ll traverse radio-active factories, slummy sewers, sterile labs, and dark mine-shafts — 10 mini-challenges, 4 mini-bots, and 1 final bot;

Stages offer 2 or more minutes each, growing exponentially with progression; Stages can be replayed to master routes, find hidden VHS tapes and compete for the fastest possible completion time and get on the global high-score board.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: DX12-compatible GPU (e.g., Intel UHD 620 / NVIDIA GT 1030 / Radeon R7 250)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 165 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible audio device (onboard audio is fine, e.g., Realtek HD Audio)
  • VR Support: N/A
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (8th gen+) / AMD Ryzen 5
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU (e.g., NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD RX 560 or better) with full DX12 support
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 165 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Dedicated or high-quality onboard sound card with stereo output and driver support for 48kHz or higher
  • VR Support: N/A

short_description: Are you an old CRT monitor with a penchant for picking up boxes? Do you long for the days when you could place those boxes in an exit portal and engage your jetpacks early because you're impatient? If you answered yes to any of these questions, you're really weird! But try Workplace Hazard anyway!
